description: CRYPTO_SPEC §6.2: target selection of the checkpoint values_digest — a variable with status = declared (§4.2 layout v2; no value set) does not appear in values_digest (2026-08-30). values_digest_hex = lower_hex(SHA-256(LP("maruhi/v1/env-values-digest", v_1, …, v_m))); v_j = LP(variable_id, version, value_sig_hash_hex) (UTF-8 byte-ascending by variable_id; active variables only). The encoder's LP canonical form is already pinned and unchanged by chain-entries.json's values_digests section — this file pins only the target-selection rule (chain-entries.json is unchanged — §11)
encoding_reference: chain-entries.json's values_digests (LP canonical form, byte-ascending, no duplicates, numbers decimal-stringified)
selection_rule: select values_digest_entries (active only) from variables (the set of variables including their statement status). An active one always carries the value coordinates of the latest version (version / value_sig_hash_hex); declared / deleted carry no value coordinates (the value-distribution requirement for active and 'not distributing a value to a declared variable is legitimate' — §6.3)

cases.name: declared-excluded
cases.note: only variables with status = active are values_digest targets (§6.2). declared (§4.2 layout v2 — no value or version exists) does not appear; a tombstone (deleted) being out of scope is the existing rule (caught on the manifest side — §4.3). The digest equals the digest of the set of only the 2 active variables

cases.name: all-declared-empty
cases.note: the values_digest of an environment with only declared variables equals the empty set's digest (equal to empty-set in chain-entries.json's values_digests) — the target-selection side of 'not distributing a value to a declared variable is legitimate' (§6.3)
